item.title: A sunny and chilly weekend ahead in southern Colorado
item.description: Temperatures will be near average or a few degrees below average this weekend in southern Colorado. The sky will be mostly sunny.

item.title: Colorado families face uncertainty amid federal child care funding cuts
item.description: Colorado families and providers face uncertainty as Trump administration's $10 billion child care funding freeze targets the state amid fraud concerns.

item.title: Avalanche advisories issued for most of Colorado's high country this weekend
item.description: Be extra careful if you're heading to the mountains to ski or hike this weekend. The latest map from the Colorado Avalanche Information Center (CAIC) shows advisories across most of the high country.
